subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pool sizing + onboarding credit request
messages:
From: Aisha Rao <aisha@horizon-analytics.com>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Cc: Grant Lee <grant.lee@horizon-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated pool sizing + discount ask

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. To summarize Horizon's request: we plan to move a critical inference workload to a reserved GPU pool. Targets are: 32x A100-equivalent cards (sustained), 2.5M tokens/day average with peak bursts up to 6M, and a 99th pctl latency target of 300ms for 512-token windows.

Procurement asked me to open the pricing discussion early — they're seeing a competitor willing to do a 30% baseline commit discount plus a $200k onboarding credit for a 12-month reserved commit.

Can Redwood provide:
- firm pricing for a 12-month reserved 32-card pool + 2:1 burst,
- throughput SLO language, and
- any flexibility on onboarding credits or first-quarter credits to offset migration costs.

We want to get an initial numbers sheet this week so procurement can compare.

Thanks,
Aisha
VP Engineering
Horizon Analytics

----
Attachment: horizon-procurement-questions.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rao <aisha@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: Grant Lee <grant.lee@horizon-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool sizing + discount ask

Aisha —

Appreciate the clear summary. Quick numbers to get a baseline in front of procurement:
- SKU: Dedicated-32-A100 (12mo reserved) — list price $48,000/GPU/mo => $18.432M list over 12mo
- Proposed reserved commit discount: 20% off list (effective $38,400/GPU/mo)
- One-time migration/onboarding credit: $75,000
- Throughput guarantee: 99th pctl latency target 300ms for defined 512-token profile; financial credits scoped in term sheet for repeat SLO misses.

I've attached a draft term sheet with the SLO language and the burst policy. I know competitive matching is on the table — happy to escalate for additional concession, but I need a quick internal ask (approx discount + credits) and the expected ARR runway to bring to leadership.

Proposed next step: 30-minute alignment call Wed afternoon to review tradeoffs (burst, pre-warming, cache strategy) and get procurement's target number.

Best,
Evelyn
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

----
Attachment: redwood-dedicated-term-sheet.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated pool sizing + discount ask — need approval for competitive match

Jordan / Ben —

Forwarding Horizon's ask. Key facts: 12mo reserved for a 32-card pool, potential ARR ~ $4.1M annualized on committed spend, competitor is offering 30% + $200k credit. Procurement is asking Redwood for a match or close.

Ask: approve up to 28% discount + $125k onboarding credit and contingent approval to add a $50k migration milestone credit if they sign within 10 business days.

Rationale:
- Strategic account with lots of platform expansion opportunities (R&D workloads later this year)
- Multi-year expansion probability high; losing to competitor would likely delay any enterprise consolidation
- We preserve margin with modest credit against first invoice and tie credits to milestones

If you approve, I will propose: 27% up front discount, $125k onboarding credit, $50k milestone credit (conditional). If you want to push to 30%/200k we need exec signoff (Vivek).

Attaching my annotated term sheet and a quick risk/impact note.

Evelyn

----
Attachment: redwood-dedicated-term-sheet-annotated.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: horizon-risk-score.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated pool sizing + discount ask — need approval for competitive match

Evelyn —

I approve moving forward with a 27% discount and $125k onboarding credit. Do not commit the $50k milestone credit without sign-off from Revenue Ops (Ben) on how it nets against invoicing. Margin math looks acceptable at 27% given the strategic upside.

Vivek — can you sign off on an exception up to 27% discount? If they push to 30% and $200k credit, we should consider exec-level trade (contract term extension to 24mo or minimum committed throughput guarantees).

Ben — please provide the invoicing language and whether the milestone credit can be structured as an invoice credit tied to arrival of production traffic.

Jordan
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

----
Note: internal discussion only.

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rao <aisha@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: Grant Lee <grant.lee@horizon-analytics.com>, jordan.blake@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool sizing + discount ask

Aisha —

Thanks for your patience while we reviewed internally. Leadership approved the following commercial:

Offer summary (final):
- 12-month reserved Dedicated-32-A100 pool (2:1 burst)
- Effective discount: 27% off list (effective $35,136/GPU/mo)
- One-time onboarding credit: $125,000 applied to first invoice
- SLA & throughput: 99th pctl latency 300ms for the agreed 512-token profile; term sheet includes financial remediation up to two months of credits scoped to repeated misses
- Milestone credit: $50,000 contingent credit available if production traffic > 80% of committed throughput within first 60 days (structured as invoice credit).

Conditional items:
- We will finalize DocuSign and need signature within 10 business days to guarantee the quoted pricing and credit schedule.
- If Horizon prefers a 24-month term, we can discuss an incremental bump to the credit figure (open to that on the call).

Next steps:
1) Review attached clean term sheet and confirm any changes to the SLO language by EOD Monday.
2) I will circulate DocuSign link for signature once we confirm the legal redlines.
3) Internal onboarding kickoff plan to be scheduled upon execution.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/initiatives/DEAL-9743 
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9743

If this matches procurement's expectation we can lock and start onboarding.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

----
Attachment: redwood-dedicated-term-sheet.pdf (application/pdf)
